BiblicalUsage: 1) to push, thrust, chase, overflow, totter, sore, drive away or out, be outcast, be cast down; 1a) (Qal) to push, push violently; 1b) (Niphal) to be thrust down, be cast down; 1c) (Pual) to be thrust down
